info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' preraRe suvati prARiprasave sUyate Bavet . prARigarBavimokeTe sUte Se Syani Sabluki ' (Slo. 25) iti devaH .

examples: 'tadyadetAByAmaprasUtaH karotyakftaM tat akftamakariti vE nindanti' (E॰brA॰10.6). aprasUtaH=anaByanujYAtaH.
'ekA dIkzA tisra upasadaH…prasUtaH' (Apa॰SrO॰10.15.1). prasUta iti yajamAnasya saYjYA.
'tadasmE savitA prasavitA prAsuvat, tatsavitfprasUta udajayat (Sa॰brA॰5.1.1.4). prAsuvat=prErayat. savitfprasUtaH=savitrA preritaH.
'viSvAni deva savitarduritAni parAsuva' (f॰5.82.5, vA॰saM॰30.3). parANmuKAni preraya, ito dUramutsArayetyAha.
'A te prARaM suvAmasi parA yakzmaM suvAmi te' (aTarva॰7.55.6). ukto'rTaH. suvAmasi=suvAmaH.
'para fRA sAvIraDa matkftAni mAhaM rAjannanyakftena Bojam' (f0 2.28.9). parAsAvIH=parAcInaM preraya=apAkuru. anfRo yaTA syAm.
'apAsya ye sinAH pASA mftyorekaSataM suve' (kAWaka0 38.13). apasuve vikirAmi visinomi vizitAnkaromi.
'tad ye ca vA ita UrDvA lokA ye cAmuto'rvAYcaH, tezAmeza etaduBayezAM vizuvati' (jE0 brA0 2.5)..
'A te prARa suvAmasi parA yakzmaM suvAmi te' (aTarva0 7.55.6). ukto'rTaH.
'asO vA AdityaH sAyamAsuvati…eza prAtaH prasuvati' (mE0 saM0 1.5.7).
'aTa hEtad devAnAM parizUtaM yad brahmacArI' (go0 brA0 pUrva0 2.7).
